description: The setup guide / progress tracker of an application: a checklist of onboarding steps the user works through, with a counted progress line, collapsible groups, an optional call-to-action per step and a celebration block once every required step is done. Pure Blazor — native checkboxes own the activation, each group header is an APG disclosure button, exactly one polite live region announces the transitions and the visible celebration is an icon plus text (no confetti, no motion-only signal).

parameters.name: Tasks
parameters.description: The steps to work through, in render order. A step without a Group renders in the leading plain list; grouped steps render under their collapsible header (groups in the order of their first step). An empty list renders the localized empty state and no progress block. The checklist writes OnboardingTask.IsDone on the instances it was given before it raises OnTaskToggle, so it works without a bound handler; a NEW list identity is treated as a new onboarding run (a dismissed checklist comes back).

parameters.name: OnTaskToggle
parameters.description: Fires after a step was toggled, with the step whose IsDone the checklist has already written. Persist the value (or the whole list) from the handler — the checklist never edits the collection itself.

parameters.name: Dismissible
parameters.description: Renders the dismiss button: an icon button whose accessible name is the localized "Dismiss checklist", a 32 px target on a fine pointer (above the 24 px minimum of WCAG 2.5.8) and a 44 px one on a coarse pointer. Default false — an onboarding guide that can vanish needs a host that can bring it back.

parameters.name: OnDismiss
parameters.description: Fires when the user dismisses the checklist. The checklist hides itself first, so a host that never binds this callback still gets a closed surface. A host that also removes the component from its layout owns the focus afterwards: move it to a stable element (a page heading or the control that opened the guide) with FocusAsync, because the button that had focus no longer exists — docs/onboarding-checklist.md shows the exact pattern.

parameters.name: Layout
parameters.description: Presentation: List (the default — a plain vertical list for a sidebar or a page section that already has a surface), Card (the setup-guide presentation on one bordered surface with the title header and progress block) or Grid (the tips-panel presentation: one tile per step in an auto-fitting grid).

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Visible title of the checklist. When set it is also the accessible name of the region (the root is a section named by this heading — HeadingLevel picks the level); when null the region keeps the localized "Onboarding checklist" name and no header row renders (unless Dismissible adds one for the close button).

parameters.name: HeadingLevel
parameters.description: Heading level of Title (1–6), so the checklist can sit under the right page heading. A value outside 1–6 falls back to 2. The title renders as role="heading" with aria-level, which keeps the level dynamic without a tag-name switch.

parameters.name: ShowProgress
parameters.description: Renders the progress block: a TmProgressBar (named by its role, "Progress", with the whole percentage as aria-valuenow) plus the counted sentence next to it ("3 of 7 tasks done" in English, grammatical plural in cs/sk/fr — the plural family keys on the TOTAL, which is what the counted noun agrees with, and takes the done count as the second argument). The sentence is not a live region; only the announcer is.

parameters.name: CollapseCompletedGroups
parameters.description: Collapses a group automatically when its last step is checked. Default false: a group that folds under the user's cursor hides the work just finished. When enabled, the focus moves from the now-hidden checkbox to that group's header (which reports aria-expanded="false"), so a keyboard user is never dropped on the document body.

parameters.name: ShowCelebration
parameters.description: Renders the celebration block — a trophy icon plus a title and a body line — once every required step is done. The block is not a live region: the completion is announced once through the announcer, so nothing is announced twice. Reduced motion neutralises its pop animation.

parameters.name: CompletedTitle
parameters.description: Title of the celebration block. Null uses the localized "All done!".

parameters.name: CompletedText
parameters.description: Body text of the celebration block. Null uses the localized sentence.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) on the root section.

examples.title: A grouped setup guide with progress, actions and dismissal
examples.code:
<TmOnboardingChecklist Tasks="Steps"
                      Title="Get started"
                      Layout="OnboardingChecklistLayout.Card"
                      Dismissible="true"
                      OnTaskToggle="HandleStepToggled"
                      OnDismiss="HandleDismissed" />

@code {
    private readonly List<OnboardingTask> Steps =
    [
        new() { Id = "workspace", Title = "Create a workspace", Group = "Basics", IsDone = true },
        new() { Id = "invite", Title = "Invite a teammate", Group = "Basics" },
        new() { Id = "data", Title = "Connect a data source", Group = "Data",
                Description = "Postgres, MSSQL or a CSV file.",
                ActionLabel = "Open settings", ActionHref = "/settings" },
        new() { Id = "changelog", Title = "Read the changelog", IsOptional = true },
    ];
}

examples.title: Auto-collapse finished groups and a custom celebration
examples.code:
<TmOnboardingChecklist Tasks="Steps"
                      CollapseCompletedGroups="true"
                      CompletedTitle="Setup finished"
                      CompletedText="Everything is ready — open your first dashboard." />
